source.title: NORAD/CONAD Historical Summary, January–June 1963
source.source_owner: North American Air Defense Command and Continental Air Defense Command

events.claim: Secretary of Defense requested camera capabilities and required accuracy analysis before the proposed network approval
Joint Chiefs asked NORAD to re-evaluate Baker-Nunn requirements
NORAD defended the requirements for a military Baker-Nunn camera network independent of reliance on scientific agencies
NORAD forwarded Baker-Nunn capability and accuracy analysis to the Joint Chiefs

cold_lake.statement: The Canadian Cold Lake camera had been placed under NORAD direct operational control by the period covered in the report
cold_lake.caveat: Operational control is not proof of a named observation, date, instrument precision or effective delivery of 528 data

independence: Same NORAD institutional reporting lineage as C241-L52 and C241-L56; RCAF Roundel C241-L55 is an editorial description, not an automatically independent 528 sensor record
